bottleneck.description: Vigoride orbital transfer vehicle in a competitive in-space transportation market with D-Orbit, Launcher (Vast), Impulse Space, Exolaunch, and Spaceflight.

dependency.key_customers: NASA (Juno RDRE payload), Spaceworks (COSMIC), commercial smallsat operators, hosted-payload defense customers
dependency.key_suppliers: SpaceX (Transporter rideshare launch), water-plasma thruster vendors, off-the-shelf bus components

editorial.notes: Momentus operates Vigoride OTVs for last-mile orbital delivery, with $3.2M Q1 2026 revenue and a Vigoride 8 mission booked for early 2027. The company removed substantial-doubt going-concern language in Q1 2026 after a $25M PIPE and convertible debt cleanup, so I am NOT flagging going-concern despite historical distress. Structurally, in-space transportation is competitive with multiple commercial OTV providers and customers (NASA, ESA) actively multi-sourcing. Microcap scale ($50M mcap) and continuing operating losses keep this a fragile but not bottlenecked operator.
